Help [[Scorch Emberspire]] satisfy his desire for revenge against the false [[Titan]] gods, by destroying the two Titans that remain in the [[Realm of Torment]]!

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Seek out and destroy the Titan, [[Securis Phasmatis]].
* Find and defeat the remaining Titan, [[Letum Contineo]].
* See Scorch Emberspire for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 75 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]
* [[Inscribed Secret]]

==Walkthrough==
If you took this follow up immediately after completing [[A Flickering Flame]] (while still in the [[Domain of Secrets]]) then the two bosses can be found a short walk south from where you defeated [[Ignis Cruor]].

Otherwise, you must return to the Gate of Secrets and collect the quest there, then travel west in the Domain of Secrets until you find the two bosses next to each other (one a Warrior the other a Mesmer). Note that these titans spawn next to each other, and do not break down into lesser titans when they die. When you have killed one you can safely move on to the other.
